title: Preflight v25 — Exp906 Root Cause + Exp954 Audit + SOTA Model Verify + Manifest Check
exp906_root_cause: 50q_scale_x_per_question_latency: experiment ran 2-model x 50-problem sequential inference loop (~1605s pure compute) on fallback E4B model. Conductor overhead adds ~8 min for total ~35 min wall time. Not a model-download issue (inference_mode=fallback_transformers_only). Not a repair-loop overrun (12/50 problems hit max_retries=3, bounded). Root cause (c): cumulative latency across 50q scale is inherent to scope.
exp906_fix_applied: CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=40 documented as required env var for Exp 906 and successors. Experiment completed successfully in the 2026.04.74 run (strong_improvement_code_repair_milestone_achieved); not retired — root cause is manageable with correct timeout budget.
